name: Higgs TTS 3
weights: open (Boson Higgs TTS 3 Research and Non-Commercial License)
access: Boson AI API: POST /v1/audio/speech, model higgs-tts-3 (hosted)
Hugging Face weights bosonai/higgs-tts-3-4b (about 4.65B parameters in the file listing)
Self-hosted with SGLang-Omni or vLLM-Omni (both OpenAI-style /v1/audio/speech servers)

voice.input_audio: Text with inline control tags (up to 5,000 characters per request on the hosted API); optional reference audio for cloning (AAC, WAV, MP3, FLAC or Opus, as a URL, data URI or base64; inline payloads up to 10 MB) with its transcript [boson-api-speech]
voice.output_audio: Hosted API: mp3 (default), opus, pcm, wav, aac or flac; streaming needs pcm. The weights decode 24 kHz audio at 25 frames per second [boson-api-speech] [hf-higgs3]
voice.voices: 6 preset voices (chloe, eleanor, jake, marcus, nora, oliver) plus zero-shot cloning from a reference clip (the maker recommends 5 to 30 seconds of clean speech) and reusable registered voices [boson-tts-voices]
languages: 102 languages with single-digit WER or CER, 85 of them under 5; language is auto-detected from the text [boson-tts-languages]
voice.turn_detection: none: a synthesis model; the maker points to Higgs Realtime for conversation [boson-tts-overview]
voice.interruption: Not a conversation model: the client stops playback and cancels the request
voice.session_limit: 5,000 characters per request on the hosted API; the maker recommends about 300 characters per request because longer text is not yet reliably supported [boson-api-speech]. The weights were trained with an 8,192-token sequence length [hf-higgs3]

pricing_usd_per_mtok.notes: Hosted API list price US$0.015 per 1,000 input characters [boson-pricing]. The weights are free for research and non-commercial use; production, hosted or embedded use needs a separate licence from Boson. A creator grant allows monetised podcasts, videos and similar content with credit to Boson [hf-higgs3]. A GPU is required; no minimum memory is stated, and Boson's throughput table used one H100 [hf-higgs3]

benchmarks.name: Artificial Analysis Speech Arena Elo (provider voice leaderboard)
benchmarks.setting: blind pairwise listener votes; listed as Higgs Audio V3 TTS, open weights; the model page headline gives 1036.42 and the leaderboard data in the same page gives 1037.9

benchmarks.name: EmergentTTS-Eval overall win rate against the baseline row (Boson table)
benchmarks.setting: judge preference; every model has the same reference audio; no inline control tags were used; baseline is the maker's chosen row

benchmarks.name: EmergentTTS-Eval emotions win rate (Boson table)
benchmarks.setting: same setting; Fish Audio S2 Pro scores 53.04, Qwen3-TTS-1.7B 45.54, MOSS-TTS-v1.5 60.54 and OmniVoice 61.07 in the same table

benchmarks.name: SeedTTS word error rate, macro average over 2 languages (lower is better)
benchmarks.setting: Boson's run; next best listed is OmniVoice at 1.21

unknown: Artificial Analysis Speech Arena latency or throughput: the model page gives an Elo only; no characters-per-second figure was read
released: the maker's blog post and the Hugging Face repository date it 2026-06-04; the weights were last changed 2026-09-04 [boson-blog-tts3] [hf-higgs3-api]
voice.latency: Boson states no time-to-first-audio figure; its card says only sub-second time to first audio when streaming on a self-hosted server [hf-higgs3]
hardware: the sources give no minimum GPU memory
